newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIALLI MISSES CALL-UP FOR ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIALLI MISSES CALL-UP FOR ITALY.

text.p: Chelsea striker Gianluca Vialli's hopes of a swift return to international soccer were dashed on Wednesday when Italy signalled he would not be called up for a friendly against Northern Ireland on January 22.
Vialli, 32, was not among foreign-based players whose clubs new national coach Cesare Maldini had to inform by Wednesday of a possible call-up under FIFA rules that require 14 days notice.
The match in the Sicilian capital Palermo will be the first under Maldini, ahead of a key World Cup qualifier against England at Wembley next month.

Vialli has not played for Italy since December 1992. The man Italy's fans always clamour for, he fell out with previous coach Arrigo Sacchi and had hoped Maldini's appointment last month could spell the start of a comeback.

Soccer federation sources said Maldini had advised English premier league club Chelsea that he could summon Gianfranco Zola and Roberto Di Matteo and Middlesbrough that he might want striker Fabrizio Ravanelli.
The notification is a precaution but Maldini was expected to call up all three players when he names his squad.
